snippet.title: Craftiny - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Craftiny on Steam today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4158360/Craftiny/?utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_source=youtube

Awaken your crafter spirit and turn your passion for handmade creations into a successful business in Craftiny! 🧵
Starting with a simple printer, gradually grow your business, customize your creations with different themes and listen to your customers to help your business thrive.

Craftiny is a cozy management game centered around handmade creations, developed by Misstic Studio.

Website: https://www.missticstudio.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/Y5XjTaWgH9
